title_as_catalogued: Biographical Catalogue of Princeton Theological Seminary 1815-1932
author: Compiled by Rev. Edward Howell Roberts, Registrar and Secretary of the Faculty
edition_notes: Official register published by the Trustees of the Seminary, compiled by the Registrar from Seminary records (not a third-party narrative history). Front matter gives a dated chronology (Act of Assembly establishing the Seminary, May 1810; Plan ratified May 1811; first Board meeting 30 June 1812; Seminary opened for instruction 12 Aug 1812; incorporated 15 Nov 1822). Faculty roster gives Alexander's and Miller's professorship dates and subsequent professors including Charles Hodge (PTS class of 1819, professor 1822-1878). Alumni entries begin with the class that entered in 1812 and completed in 1815.
